bio_en: Iskuhi Tiriakian was born in Constantinople on 1 May 1874, studied at the Narekian school and the Pera girls' vocational school, and taught there and at the national school of Makrikoy. Influenced by her teacher Melkon Gurjian (Hrant), she joined a Hnchakian women's group in 1890 and helped prepare the Patriarchate demonstration. In 1896 she moved with her parents to Varna and taught at the national school; in 1901 she married Hrach of the Bank Ottoman action and became his partner in the cause, enduring six months in prison after a terrorist act led to searches and arrests. She died in Zagazig, Egypt, on 14 November 1930, leaving an autobiography published in Yusaber.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Her husband 'Hrach of the Bank Ottoman' is not otherwise identified in the text read.
